scope: Free fermion exchange, a coupled-channel Hamiltonian, and a leading zero-range dimer EFT. Not a string construction or experimental fit.
checks_passed: Dirac inverse has the scalar mass-shell denominator
Off-source Helmholtz equation and nonzero massless spatial derivative
Yukawa/Coulomb spatial Green function from an independent proper-time integral
Low-transfer expansion gives a contact term and derivative corrections
Eigenvalues of a Hamiltonian in a fixed total-parity two-channel basis
Renormalized zero-range dimer has finite, tunable radius and nontrivial form factor
coupled_channel_eigenvalues: +/- sqrt(delta^2/4 + |K|^2), relative to the mean channel energy
dimer_form_factor: 4*atan(a*Q/4)/(a*Q), equal masses and one charged constituent
